projects.title: Reversi
projects.description: Play Reversi against an original search engine, compare legal moves with the strategy coach, and replay your decisions to explore different continuations.
projects.note: Play directly in your browser, including on iPhone.

image.alt: Reversi board after two moves, alongside the coach’s ranked legal moves and search scores.
image.caption: Actual browser game and strategy coach

projects.title: arXiv Shelf
projects.description: A searchable local library for arXiv PDFs, with titles, authors, abstracts, ratings, and tools for finding and opening papers across computers.
projects.note: The public site explains the project. Its separately hosted browser library may require access permission.

image.alt: Publicly documented arXiv Shelf screenshot showing paper search, filters, ratings, and a list of papers.
image.caption: Browser edition · screenshot from the public project site

projects.title: Recipes
projects.description: A searchable, printable collection of family recipes and recipes recovered from earlier notes and conversations. Ingredients and instructions appear together in cooking order.
projects.note: Preserves the original recipe formatting, with optional higher contrast and a printer-friendly layout.

site.detail: Browse and print recipes · GitHub Pages

projects.title: Beads
projects.description: Photographs, procedural bead geometry, and POV-Ray models for studying beaded ropes and recovering their repeating color patterns. Related image-analysis tools appear below.
projects.note: Strong 208-position candidate; physical count, exact topology, and the original chart remain independently unverified.

site.detail: Project introduction & pattern viewer · GitHub Pages

image.alt: A red, yellow, and black beaded rope arranged on a pink background, used as a photographic reference.
image.caption: Original photographic reference from the repository

projects.title: MadWeave
projects.description: Design triaxial weaves with three directions of interlacing strips. Explore patterns, colors, layers and spacing; save editable projects for offline use or export SVG artwork.
projects.note: Save and reopen complete projects, including original editable SVG files. Use a mouse or trackpad; full keyboard/touch controls remain future work.

image.alt: Madweave interface showing a pink, yellow, and purple triaxial weave with color and pattern controls.
image.caption: Existing Madweave interface image

site.detail: GitHub Pages · interactive editor, offline project saving, and user guide

projects.title: Navier–Stokes Vortex Lab
projects.description: A Python and POV-Ray pipeline for visualizing finite-scale swirling flow, alongside research into boundary control and the feasibility of a physical water experiment.
projects.note: The rendered tracer model is a kinematic analogue, not a validated Navier–Stokes solution or a demonstration of a singularity.

image.alt: POV-Ray preview of a transparent blue tank containing green tracer markers.
image.caption: Repository render · illustrative tracer visualization

projects.title: Navier–Stokes Physical Approximation
projects.description: Investigates finite approximations, scale separation, pressure schedules, and numerical residuals in concentrating-flow models, with reproducible experiments and preserved negative results.
projects.note: Experimental models remain outside the theorem’s assumptions. No nonlinear core solution or physical realizability is established.

image.alt: Four comparison plots of radial, azimuthal, and axial velocity and speed at different scales; nonlinear core corrections are omitted.
image.caption: Published baseline · explicit comparison profiles

projects.title: Symphonium Disc Maker
projects.description: Turn note arrangements into SVG and DXF geometry for a 20-note music-box disc, with measured track layouts, drive holes, and printable labels.
projects.note: Reverse-engineering and prototype work; manufactured fit and playback remain to be tested.

image.alt: Generated Pachelbel sampler disc drawing with circular note tracks, music holes, and a ring of drive holes.
image.caption: Actual generated Pachelbel sampler disc geometry

projects.title: FFT Image Explorer
projects.description: Inspect color images in spatial and frequency domains. Adjust channels, masks, windows, and frequency filters, then compare the input, FFT, and reconstructed image.
projects.note: Runs in a local desktop window. Includes a bracelet boundary and centerline scanner.

projects.title: Bead Map
projects.description: Python experiments for detecting bead regions and tracing bracelet centerlines from color masks.

projects.title: HSV Tools
projects.description: Pick HSV color ranges, inspect color counts, and produce masks for photographic bead analysis.

projects.title: Sound
projects.description: C experiments in Fourier transforms, harmonics, test signals, and plotting.

projects.title: HIS Profile
projects.description: Collect and explore IBM z/OS Hardware Instrumentation Services profiling data, including tree views in notebooks.

projects.title: z/OS Python
projects.description: Python and C interfaces for z/OS system services, including datasets, dynamic allocation, job submission, and profiling.

projects.title: IzODA documentation
projects.description: Preserved website source for IBM Open Data Analytics for z/OS, covering Anaconda, Spark, and Open Data Layer. Its old public homepage is unavailable.

projects.title: NumPy fork
projects.description: An older fork of NumPy, the scientific computing library. Retained here for discoverability; this is not the upstream project.
